summary: Pony AI Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing the poll results of its annual general meeting held on June 8, 2026. All eight ordinary resolutions proposed were duly passed by shareholders, including the adoption of audited financial statements and election of directors. The filing is a routine corporate governance update with no special situation event such as a strategic transaction, capital return, or restructuring. It does not trigger any special-situation categorization under event-driven analysis.
